text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are moving in lockstep with modest gains, suggesting steady rather than conviction-driven buying after a recent pullback in sentiment. The Fear & Greed index at 51 (neutral) and declining over the week indicates markets are cautious, with BTC dominance holding firm at 59.5% as investors favor the largest assets over altcoins during this uncertain period. Volume at $69B is moderate, reflecting a market consolidating rather than accelerating in either direction.
